name: eToro Group Ltd.
summary: eToro Group Ltd. engages in the development, management, and provision of online trading software solutions and services. The firm's trading platform, eToro, allows users to trade financial instruments. It also enables non-professionals to trade in markets that were previously the exclusive arena of professional investors. The company was founded by Johnathan Alexander Assia, Guy Gamzu, David Ring, and Ronen Assia on December 14, 2006 and is headquartered in Bnei Braq, Israel.
